sources.name: Steam 热销榜规则
sources.note: 近24小时收入、最近3小时加权，包含本体、DLC与内购，不是售出份数。

sources.name: Steam 当前在线人数

methodology: 动态发现的最多60款独立游戏样本：来自Steam美国区Indie热销/最近发行各前100条，至少有一个紧凑玩法标签，免费或美国区原价不高于25美元；排除DLC、软件、Demo和未发售作品。这些条件只是小体量的筛选代理，不代表已核实团队规模、制作预算或Steam全库排名。
候选按4款热销、1款最近发行轮流检查，符合规则后截取最多60款；所有排名仅在这一发现样本内比较。
近1/7/30天评价量按同一采集时点向前24/168/720小时，以评论创建时间统计；不是评论总数差值，也不是销量。
期间好评率=期间好评数/期间评价量；无评价时不计算比例。全部语言、全部购买渠道，过滤Steam离题评论活动。
当前热销为美国区Indie搜索榜顺位；全球榜位仅引用已核实全球来源的前100榜单，未入榜不视为0。
实时热销按近24小时收入并加权最近3小时，不能解释成纯24小时销量榜。没有公开滚动7/30天销量或下载榜。
商店资料缓存7天，本页数据每日采集、23小时内复用；失败保留旧值及原时间并标记过期，不把缺失写成0。
小游戏是本页筛选口径，Indie和低价本身不证明制作规模；玩法标签包括休闲、解谜、平台跳跃、Roguelite、卡牌、放置等。

games.name: Moon Sweepers
games.description: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

games.name: Slay the Spire 2
games.description: The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2!

games.name: One More Lawn
games.description: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

games.name: Onward! Autobattles
games.description: Plan your line-up, set your formation and unleash devastating synergies to crush your enemies. Win battles to unlock more unique units and powerful artifacts in Onward! Autobattles - a roguelike autobattler, where positioning is everything.

games.name: Dice Hoarder
games.description: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

games.name: Dressmaker
games.description: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

games.name: BALL x PIT
games.description: BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes.

games.name: 旋转吧！小陀螺！
games.description: A spinning top battle game: whip your top to control its speed and position, and knock down your rival's. Four whips with different feel, mic-based summoning, solo campaign, local 2P and LAN duels.

games.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2
games.description: Travel across Europe as king of the road, a trucker who delivers important cargo across impressive distances! With dozens of cities to explore, your endurance, skill and speed will all be pushed to their limits.

games.name: Risk of Rain 2
games.description: Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of frenzied monsters – with your friends, or on your own. Combine loot in surprising ways and master each character until you become the havoc you feared upon your first crash landing.

games.name: Potato Please
games.description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

games.name: Healing Time
games.description: Healing Time is a game about sitting with friends on a photoreal seaside. Under a parasol by day and beside a campfire by night, listen to the waves and the fire while you talk or simply rest.

games.name: 9 Kings
games.description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

games.name: Water Polo: Arcade World Cup
games.description: Fast, readable 7v7 arcade water polo. Pick a nation, thread passes through the defense, and outfox the keeper. Chase tournament glory, sharpen your skills in practice, or play with friends online in matches for up to eight players.

games.name: Warhammer Survivors
games.description: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

games.name: Stardew Valley
games.description: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools and a few coins, you set out to begin your new life. Can you learn to live off the land and turn these overgrown fields into a thriving home?

games.name: over the hill
games.description: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Slotbound
games.description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

games.name: Light the Void
games.description: Light the Void is a pixel-art incremental exploration game. Reveal a mysterious world one tile at a time, gather resources, restore ancient structures, and unlock powerful upgrades. Grow your void world, overcome colossal titans, and bring light.

games.name: Can 'Em All
games.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

games.name: 天陨传
games.description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder blending Chinese cultivation and Western fantasy. Read enemy intent, chain spirit swords, or reroll fortune with chips. The free demo includes two classes, each with a three-act journey. Game interface: Simplified Chinese only.

games.name: BOMBANANA!
games.description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

games.name: Find The Needle
games.description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

games.name: TOUCHLINE CAPITAL
games.description: Touchline Capital is an emergent football business simulation where you run an agency rather than a club. Scout and sign players, assign agents, arrange moves, build commercial value, invest in projects, and expand into new markets around the world.

games.name: Brawlhalla
games.description: An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or local. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android & Steam! Frequent updates. Over sixty Legends.

games.name: Water TD
games.description: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.

games.name: Tabletop Simulator
games.description: Tabletop Simulator is the only simulator where you can let your aggression out by flipping the table! There are no rules to follow: just you, a physics sandbox, and your friends. Make your own online board games or play the thousands of community created mods. Unlimited gaming possibilities!

games.name: RV There Yet?
games.description: A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

games.name: Clara Wraiths 3
games.description: Clara Wraiths 3 is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a psychic, called Clara, who investigates the various haunted locations in the US in order to help the spirits move on or find peace.

games.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
games.description: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth
games.description: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth is a randomly generated action RPG shooter with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following Isaac on his journey players will find bizarre treasures that change Isaac’s form giving him super human abilities and enabling him to fight off droves of mysterious creatures, discover

games.name: How They Built the Pyramids
games.description: A chaotic online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Make bricks, build a giant pyramid and turn a small operation into a massive automated production line. Work together, hire help and find increasingly ridiculous ways to get those bricks to the top.

games.name: Roadkill
games.description: The City Streets are Dangerous for a Single Raccoon! Dodge Vehicles, Scavenge Food, and Manage your Child's Insatiable Appetite!

games.name: GRAND TIDDY ADVENTURES 🚨
games.description: Crime pays in this city, but the girls want their cut too. 💋 Rise from small-time crook to legend of the neon streets, charm the women who can open the right doors, and keep your foot on the gas when the sirens get too close

games.name: Escape the Backrooms
games.description: Escape the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Traverse 30+ eerie backrooms levels while avoiding entities and other dangers. Try to escape but be warned: survival isn't guaranteed.

games.name: Just Beat It
games.description: A pixel-art bullet hell set in a medieval city ruled by magic, where every bullet pattern is timed to the music. You're invincible while dashing, and passing close to bullets scores points. Play solo, or with two players on one PC.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

games.name: Supermarket Simulator
games.description: Run your own supermarket! Stock shelves, set your prices, take payments, hire staff, expand your store, handle shoplifters, and design your layout. Purchase goods from online or local markets around town, and personally deliver online orders to your customers.

games.name: Terraria
games.description: Dig, fight, explore, build! Nothing is impossible in this action-packed adventure game. Four Pack also available!

games.name: Hold Your Frogs
games.description: Play solo against the computer in Hold Your Frogs! Dodge traffic as a frog or command the cars. Then try local two-player matches or Steam online 1v1 and 4v4. Swap sides at halftime and win with your skill build, timing and prediction.

games.name: Tape to Tape
games.description: Tape to Tape is a roguelite hockey game where every choice matters on your journey to build the best hockey team. Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

games.name: Work From Dungeon
games.description: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.

games.name: MECCHA CHAMELEON
games.description: Paint yourself to blend in! "Meccha Chameleon" is a new-sensation hide-and-seek game where you paint your white body to mimic the stage. Spot, pose, and "artistic skill" are keys to survival. Deceive Seekers with techniques that put chameleons to shame! Supports public matches and streaming.

games.name: Machinarium
games.description: Machinarium is the award-winning adventure game from the makers of Phonopolis, CHUCHEL and the Samorost series. Help Josef the robot save his girlfriend Berta, kidnapped by the Black Cap Brotherhood gang!

games.name: Cult of the Lamb
games.description: Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland Followers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

games.name: THE NOM MUST BE FED
games.description: NOM ate your friends, and your weapons can’t kill him. Smash fruit monsters for pulp, buy upgrades, and save enough food to keep him from eating you. To get your friends out, you’ll have to feed him until he explodes. A 3D active incremental game.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

games.name: SONIC PICO PARK
games.description: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

games.name: Go Next!
games.description: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 11 worlds, and turn 71 weapons and 131 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

games.name: CoreCrawler
games.description: Land a cute little harvesting crawler on a beautiful, living alien world. Grind up the adorable locals, grow into a rolling city, carpet-bomb every biome you leave, then rip out the planet's heart and fly home. Your AI supervisor PAL thinks you're doing amazing.

games.name: Happy Wheels
games.description: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.

games.name: Project: Home!
games.description: After losing your job, you return to your hometown to rebuild your life—and your family house. But you’re not alone. Two old friends, Lola and Mira, offer to help you renovate… and maybe build something more.

games.name: Thronefall
games.description: A minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom.

games.name: GO, STOP
games.description: A roguelike deckbuilder built on hwatu, Korea's flower cards. It's 1999 and you owe a Busan loan shark ₩200,000,000. Match cards, stack charms, blow up the multiplier, and call "Go" to double the pot. Interest comes due every third night.

games.name: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
games.description: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum! is a cozy skeleton restoration sim. Identify, collect, and piece together around 2,000 scattered dinosaur bones. Feel chaos turn into order, and with every skeleton you rebuild, the museum reveals another secret.

games.name: Stash Mayhem
games.description: Run a medieval-fantasy warehouse in this roguelike for 1 to 4 players online. Sort the goods your way while it's calm, survive the rush of impatient customers and upgrade your warehouse every night. The only map is in your head. Know where everything is, or just embrace the mayhem.

games.name: IdleOn - The Incremental MMO
games.description: The incremental idle MMO where your heroes keep fighting while you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental-Wizard to Cannon-Pirate, and level 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and Construction!

games.name: Revolution Idle
games.description: Revolution Idle is a free idle incremental game with offline progress, prestige layers, and endless automation. Start simple, reach infinity and go further.

games.name: Komorebi Slime Ranch
games.description: Pet slimes, gather materials, and let your ranch do the work. Raise six slime species, automate feeding and shipping, and fulfill town orders in this cozy incremental game. Rebirth unlocks lasting upgrades as you grow across four ranches.

games.name: Garry's Mod
games.description: Garry's Mod is a physics sandbox. There aren't any predefined aims or goals. We give you the tools and leave you to play.
